title: Protocol Shape
statement: Implement `solve(classes)`. `classes` is a list of `{"name": ..., "methods": [...]}`. A class satisfies the send contract when `send` is in its methods. Return the names that satisfy it, in input order. Inheritance is not required.
constraints: send is the only required method
hints: Look at the methods list, not the class name.
Keep names where send is present.
A class named Email without send does not qualify.
editorial: A Protocol checks structure. Any object with send matches, whether or not it subclasses a channel base. Nominal inheritance without the method does not match. The filter is membership of the method name.
reference_solution:
def solve(classes):
    return [item["name"] for item in classes if "send" in item["methods"]]
